mapper.select:
SELECT vendor_id AS vendorId, vendor_code AS vendorCode, vendor_name AS vendorName, contact_name AS contactName, phone, email, active, created_at AS createdAt FROM vendor
AND (vendor_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR vendor_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR contact_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND active = #{active}
ORDER BY vendor_id

SELECT mr.request_id AS requestId, mr.production_plan_id AS productionPlanId, mr.department_id AS departmentId, d.department_name AS departmentName, mr.item_id AS itemId, i.item_code AS itemCode, i.item_name AS itemName, i.unit, mr.request_qty AS requestQty, mr.issued_qty AS issuedQty, COALESCE(inv.current_qty, 0) AS currentQty, GREATEST(mr.request_qty - mr.issued_qty - COALESCE(inv.current_qty, 0), 0) AS shortageQty, mr.required_date AS requiredDate, mr.status, mr.requested_by AS requestedBy, u.user_name AS requestedByName, mr.created_at AS createdAt FROM material_request mr INNER JOIN item i ON i.item_id = mr.item_id INNER JOIN department d ON d.department_id = mr.department_id INNER JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = mr.requested_by LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.item_id = mr.item_id AND inv.department_id = mr.department_id WHERE mr.request_id = #{requestId} AND mr.status = 'SHORTAGE' AND GREATEST(mr.request_qty - mr.issued_qty - COALESCE(inv.current_qty, 0), 0) > 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM procurement p WHERE p.material_request_id = mr.request_id AND p.status != 'CANCELLED' )

SELECT vendor_id AS vendorId, vendor_code AS vendorCode, vendor_name AS vendorName, contact_name AS contactName, phone, email, address, active, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM vendor WHERE vendor_id = #{vendorId}
SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.login_id AS loginId, u.user_name AS userName, u.role, u.active, u.created_at AS createdAt FROM app_user u WHERE u.vendor_id = #{vendorId} ORDER BY u.user_id

SELECT mr.request_id AS requestId, mr.production_plan_id AS productionPlanId, mr.department_id AS departmentId, d.department_name AS departmentName, mr.item_id AS itemId, i.item_code AS itemCode, i.item_name AS itemName, i.unit, mr.request_qty AS requestQty, mr.issued_qty AS issuedQty, COALESCE(inv.current_qty, 0) AS currentQty, GREATEST( mr.request_qty - mr.issued_qty - COALESCE(inv.current_qty, 0), 0 ) AS shortageQty, mr.required_date AS requiredDate, mr.status, mr.requested_by AS requestedBy, u.user_name AS requestedByName, mr.created_at AS createdAt FROM material_request mr INNER JOIN item i ON i.item_id = mr.item_id INNER JOIN department d ON d.department_id = mr.department_id INNER JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = mr.requested_by LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.item_id = mr.item_id AND inv.department_id = mr.department_id WHERE mr.status = 'SHORTAGE' AND GREATEST( mr.request_qty - mr.issued_qty - COALESCE(inv.current_qty, 0), 0 ) > 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM procurement p WHERE p.material_request_id = mr.request_id AND p.status != 'CANCELLED' ) ORDER BY mr.required_date, mr.request_id

SELECT p.procurement_id AS procurementId, p.material_request_id AS materialRequestId, mr.production_plan_id AS productionPlanId, p.department_id AS departmentId, d.department_name AS departmentName, p.item_id AS itemId, i.item_code AS itemCode, i.item_name AS itemName, i.unit, p.request_qty AS requestQty, p.required_date AS requiredDate, p.quote_deadline AS quoteDeadline, p.selected_vendor_id AS selectedVendorId, v.vendor_name AS selectedVendorName, p.order_qty AS orderQty, p.unit_price AS unitPrice, p.received_qty AS receivedQty, p.status, p.ordered_at AS orderedAt, p.created_by AS createdBy, u.user_name AS createdByName, p.created_at AS createdAt FROM procurement p LEFT JOIN material_request mr ON mr.request_id = p.material_request_id INNER JOIN department d ON d.department_id = p.department_id INNER JOIN item i ON i.item_id = p.item_id INNER JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = p.created_by LEFT JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id = p.selected_vendor_id
AND (CAST(p.procurement_id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR i.item_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR i.item_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR v.vendor_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND p.status = #{status}
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.procurement_id DESC

SELECT p.procurement_id AS procurementId, p.department_id AS departmentId, d.department_name AS departmentName,
p.material_request_id AS materialRequestId, mr.production_plan_id AS productionPlanId, mr.status AS materialRequestStatus, mr.request_qty AS materialRequestQty, mr.issued_qty AS materialRequestIssuedQty, mr.required_date AS materialRequestRequiredDate,
p.item_id AS itemId, i.item_code AS itemCode, i.item_name AS itemName, i.spec, i.unit,
p.request_qty AS requestQty, p.required_date AS requiredDate, p.quote_deadline AS quoteDeadline,
p.selected_vendor_id AS selectedVendorId, v.vendor_code AS selectedVendorCode, v.vendor_name AS selectedVendorName, v.contact_name AS selectedVendorContactName, v.phone AS selectedVendorPhone, v.email AS selectedVendorEmail,
p.order_qty AS orderQty, p.unit_price AS unitPrice, p.received_qty AS receivedQty, p.status, p.ordered_at AS orderedAt, p.shipped_at AS shippedAt, p.received_at AS receivedAt, p.inspection_result AS inspectionResult, p.terms,
p.created_by AS createdBy, u.user_name AS createdByName, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM procurement p INNER JOIN department d ON d.department_id = p.department_id INNER JOIN item i ON i.item_id = p.item_id INNER JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = p.created_by LEFT JOIN material_request mr ON mr.request_id = p.material_request_id LEFT JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id = p.selected_vendor_id WHERE p.procurement_id = #{procurementId}

SELECT q.quote_id AS quoteId, q.procurement_id AS procurementId, p.status AS procurementStatus, p.selected_vendor_id AS selectedVendorId, p.item_id AS itemId, i.item_code AS itemCode, i.item_name AS itemName, i.unit, p.request_qty AS requestQty, q.vendor_id AS vendorId, v.vendor_code AS vendorCode, v.vendor_name AS vendorName, q.status, q.unit_price AS unitPrice, q.unit_price * p.request_qty AS totalPrice, q.delivery_date AS deliveryDate, p.required_date AS requiredDate, p.quote_deadline AS quoteDeadline, q.terms, q.submitted_at AS submittedAt, q.created_at AS createdAt, q.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM vendor_quote q INNER JOIN procurement p ON p.procurement_id = q.procurement_id INNER JOIN item i ON i.item_id = p.item_id INNER JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id = q.vendor_id
AND (CAST(q.quote_id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CAST(q.procurement_id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR i.item_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR i.item_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR v.vendor_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR v.vendor_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND q.status = #{status}
ORDER BY q.procurement_id DESC, CASE q.status WHEN 'SUBMITTED' THEN 0 WHEN 'SELECTED' THEN 1 WHEN 'REQUESTED' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, q.unit_price IS NULL, q.unit_price, q.quote_id
mapper.update:
UPDATE procurement p INNER JOIN vendor_quote q ON q.procurement_id = p.procurement_id AND q.quote_id = #{quoteId} INNER JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id = q.vendor_id AND v.active = 1 SET p.selected_vendor_id = q.vendor_id, p.order_qty = p.request_qty, p.unit_price = q.unit_price, p.terms = q.terms, p.status = 'SELECTED' WHERE p.procurement_id = #{procurementId} AND p.status = 'QUOTING' AND q.status = 'SUBMITTED' AND q.unit_price IS NOT NULL AND q.delivery_date IS NOT NULL
AND p.department_id = #{departmentId}

UPDATE procurement p INNER JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id = p.selected_vendor_id AND v.active = 1 SET p.terms = #{terms}, p.status = 'CONTRACTED' WHERE p.procurement_id = #{procurementId} AND p.status = 'SELECTED' AND p.selected_vendor_id IS NOT NULL AND p.unit_price IS NOT NULL
AND p.department_id = #{departmentId}

UPDATE procurement p INNER JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id = p.selected_vendor_id AND v.active = 1 SET p.order_qty = #{orderQty}, p.required_date = #{requiredDate}, p.status = 'ORDERED', p.ordered_at = NOW() WHERE p.procurement_id = #{procurementId} AND p.status = 'CONTRACTED' AND p.selected_vendor_id IS NOT NULL AND p.unit_price IS NOT NULL AND p.terms IS NOT NULL AND #{orderQty} = p.request_qty
AND p.department_id = #{departmentId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.procurement_id AS procurementId, i.item_code AS itemCode, i.item_name AS itemName, i.unit, v.vendor_name AS vendorName, p.order_qty AS orderQty, p.required_date AS requiredDate, p.status, p.ordered_at AS orderedAt, p.shipped_at AS shippedAt, p.received_at AS receivedAt, p.inspection_result AS inspectionResult, CASE p.status WHEN 'ORDERED' THEN '발주 전달 완료' WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN '협력회사 제작 중' WHEN 'SHIPPED' THEN '협력회사 출하 완료' WHEN 'RECEIVED' THEN '자재 입고 완료' WHEN 'RETURNED' THEN '반품·보완 진행' WHEN 'RETURN_REQUESTED' THEN '반품 요청' WHEN 'RESUPPLYING' THEN '재공급 진행' WHEN 'CLOSED' THEN '발주 마감' ELSE p.status END AS makeProgress, CASE WHEN p.status = 'ORDERED' THEN '제작 대기' WHEN p.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN '납기 진행 중' WHEN p.status = 'SHIPPED' THEN '입고 대기' WHEN p.status = 'RECEIVED' THEN '입고 완료' WHEN p.status = 'CLOSED' THEN '업무 완료' WHEN p.status IN ('RETURNED','RETURN_REQUESTED','RESUPPLYING') THEN '보완 필요' ELSE '확인 필요' END AS deliveryProgress, CASE WHEN p.status = 'ORDERED' THEN 20 WHEN p.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 50 WHEN p.status = 'SHIPPED' THEN 80 WHEN p.status IN ('RECEIVED','CLOSED') THEN 100 WHEN p.status IN ('RETURNED','RETURN_REQUESTED','RESUPPLYING') THEN 80 ELSE 0 END AS deliveryProgressRate FROM procurement p INNER JOIN item i ON i.item_id = p.item_id INNER JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id = p.selected_vendor_id WHERE p.status IN ( 'ORDERED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'SHIPPED', 'RECEIVED', 'RETURNED', 'RETURN_REQUESTED', 'RESUPPLYING', 'CLOSED' ) ORDER BY CASE p.status WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 0 WHEN 'ORDERED' THEN 1 WHEN 'SHIPPED' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, p.required_date, p.procurement_id DESC

SELECT p.procurement_id AS procurementId, i.item_code AS itemCode, i.item_name AS itemName, i.unit, v.vendor_name AS vendorName, p.order_qty AS orderQty, p.received_qty AS receivedQty, COALESCE(inv.current_qty, 0) AS inventoryQty, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(sm.quantity) FROM stock_movement sm WHERE sm.reference_type = 'PROCUREMENT' AND sm.reference_id = p.procurement_id AND sm.movement_type = 'IN' ), 0) AS movementQty, p.inspection_result AS inspectionResult, p.status, p.shipped_at AS shippedAt, p.received_at AS receivedAt, ( SELECT MAX(sm.created_at) FROM stock_movement sm WHERE sm.reference_type = 'PROCUREMENT' AND sm.reference_id = p.procurement_id AND sm.movement_type = 'IN' ) AS movementAt, CASE WHEN inv.item_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(sm.quantity) FROM stock_movement sm WHERE sm.reference_type = 'PROCUREMENT' AND sm.reference_id = p.procurement_id AND sm.movement_type = 'IN' ), 0) >= COALESCE(p.received_qty, 0) AND COALESCE(p.received_qty, 0) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS inventoryApplied, CASE WHEN p.status = 'RECEIVED' AND p.inspection_result = 'ACCEPTED' AND COALESCE(p.received_qty, 0) >= p.order_qty AND inv.item_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(sm.quantity) FROM stock_movement sm WHERE sm.reference_type = 'PROCUREMENT' AND sm.reference_id = p.procurement_id AND sm.movement_type = 'IN' ), 0) >= p.received_qty THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS readyToClose FROM procurement p INNER JOIN item i ON i.item_id = p.item_id INNER JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id = p.selected_vendor_id LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.department_id = p.department_id AND inv.item_id = p.item_id
AND (p.status IN ( 'SHIPPED', 'RECEIVED', 'RETURNED', 'RETURN_REQUESTED', 'RESUPPLYING', 'CLOSED' ) OR p.received_at IS NOT NULL)
AND (CAST(p.procurement_id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR i.item_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR i.item_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR v.vendor_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND p.status = #{status}
ORDER BY COALESCE(p.received_at, p.shipped_at) DESC, p.procurement_id DESC
mapper.update:
UPDATE procurement SET status = 'CLOSED' WHERE procurement_id = #{procurementId} AND status = 'RECEIVED' AND inspection_result = 'ACCEPTED' AND received_at IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(received_qty, 0) >= order_qty AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inventory inv WHERE inv.department_id = procurement.department_id AND inv.item_id = procurement.item_id ) AND COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(sm.quantity) FROM stock_movement sm WHERE sm.reference_type = 'PROCUREMENT' AND sm.reference_id = procurement.procurement_id AND sm.movement_type = 'IN' ), 0) >= received_qty
AND department_id = #{departmentId}
mapper.select: SELECT vendor_id AS vendorId, vendor_code AS vendorCode, vendor_name AS vendorName, contact_name AS contactName, phone, email, active, created_at AS createdAt FROM vendor WHERE active = 1 ORDER BY vendor_name, vendor_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vendor ( vendor_code, vendor_name, contact_name, phone, email, address, active ) VALUES ( #{vendorCode}, #{vendorName}, NULLIF(#{contactName}, ''), NULLIF(#{phone}, ''), NULLIF(#{email}, ''), NULLIF(#{address}, ''), 1 )
mapper.update: UPDATE vendor SET vendor_code = #{form.vendorCode}, vendor_name = #{form.vendorName}, contact_name = NULLIF(#{form.contactName}, ''), phone = NULLIF(#{form.phone}, ''), email = NULLIF(#{form.email}, ''), address = NULLIF(#{form.address}, ''), active = #{form.active} WHERE vendor_id = #{vendorId}
UPDATE vendor SET active = 0 WHERE vendor_id = #{vendorId} AND active = 1
mapper.select: SELECT mr.request_id AS requestId, mr.production_plan_id AS productionPlanId, mr.department_id AS departmentId, mr.item_id AS itemId, i.item_code AS itemCode, i.item_name AS itemName, i.unit, mr.request_qty AS requestQty, mr.issued_qty AS issuedQty, COALESCE(inv.current_qty, 0) AS currentQty, GREATEST( mr.request_qty - mr.issued_qty - COALESCE(inv.current_qty, 0), 0 ) AS shortageQty, mr.required_date AS requiredDate, mr.status, mr.requested_by AS requestedBy, mr.created_at AS createdAt FROM material_request mr INNER JOIN item i ON i.item_id = mr.item_id LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.item_id = mr.item_id AND inv.department_id = mr.department_id WHERE mr.request_id = #{requestId} AND mr.status = 'SHORTAGE' AND GREATEST( mr.request_qty - mr.issued_qty - COALESCE(inv.current_qty, 0), 0 ) > 0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM procurement WHERE material_request_id = #{materialRequestId} AND status != 'CANCELLED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO procurement ( department_id, material_request_id, item_id, request_qty, required_date, quote_deadline, status, created_by ) SELECT #{departmentId}, mr.request_id, mr.item_id, GREATEST( mr.request_qty - mr.issued_qty - COALESCE(inv.current_qty, 0), 0 ), mr.required_date, #{quoteDeadline}, 'REQUESTED', #{createdBy} FROM material_request mr LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.item_id = mr.item_id AND inv.department_id = mr.department_id WHERE mr.request_id = #{materialRequestId} AND mr.status = 'SHORTAGE' AND GREATEST( mr.request_qty - mr.issued_qty - COALESCE(inv.current_qty, 0), 0 ) > 0
mapper.update:
UPDATE procurement SET quote_deadline = #{quoteDeadline}, terms = NULLIF(#{terms}, '') WHERE procurement_id = #{procurementId} AND status = 'REQUESTED'
AND department_id = #{departmentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vendor_quote ( procurement_id, vendor_id, status ) SELECT #{procurementId}, v.vendor_id, 'REQUESTED' FROM vendor v WHERE v.vendor_id = #{vendorId} AND v.active = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vendor_quote vq WHERE vq.procurement_id = #{procurementId} AND vq.vendor_id = #{vendorId} )
